title: Avon parfüm ve kolonya
bio: Avon markasının koku veri tabanımızda 1392 parfümü bulunmaktadır. Avon eski bir parfüm evidir. En eski ürün 1934 yılında, en yenisi ise 2026 yılında piyasaya sürülmüştür. Avon parfümler parfümörlerle işbirliği içinde yapılmıştır Marion Costero, Stephen Nilsen, Frank Vöelkl, Adilson Rato, Olivier Cresp, Harry Fremont, Carlos Viñals, Nathalie Benareau, Givaudan, Maurice Roucel, Jean-Pierre Subrenat, Bruno Jovanovic, Celine Barel, Nelly Hachem-Ruiz, Andrew Everett, Calice Becker, Ellen Molner, Ann Gottlieb, Rodrigo Flores-Roux, Annie Buzantian, IFF, Carmita Magalhães, Sonia Constant, Reese Witherspoon, Natalie Gracia-Cetto, Ilias Ermenidis, Honorine Blanc, Alexis Grugeon, Pascal Gaurin, Clement Gavarry, Yann Vasnier, Alexandra Monet, Yves Cassar, Steve DeMercado, Christian Truc, Bernard Ellena, Jean-Marc Chaillan, Jean-Louis Grauby, Guillaume Flavigny, Gabriela Chelariu, Laurent Le Guernec, Frank Voelkl, Pierre Negrin, Olivier Gillotin, Leandro Petit, Rafael Marano, Jean-Christophe Hérault, Christian Alori, Eurico Mazzini, Nathalie Lorson, Pierre-Constantin Guéros, Emilie Coppermann, Alexandra Carlin, Nathalie Feisthauer, Jerry Caiazzo, Caroline Sabas, Jacques Huclier, Michelle DeFina, Adriana Medina-Baez, David Apel, Christelle Laprade, Mike Parrot, Symrise, Clito Hoedicke, Loc Dong, Francisca Perez Areias, Louis Truc, Florian Gallo, Maria Tereza Belotti, Alexandre Freile, Carlos Benaïm, Ursula Wandel, Richard Herpin, Barbara Zoebelein, Carmita Magalhaes, René Morgenthaler, Xavier Renard, Olivier Glotin, Hernan Fígoli, Marypierre Julien, Antoine Lie, Veronica Casanova, Mackenzie Reilly, Verônica Casanova, Nicolas Beaulieu, Julien Rasquinet, Fanny Grau, John Gamba, Vincent Kuczinski, David Beach, Thomas DiGiacomo, Christophe Raynaud, dsm-firmenich, Delphine Jelk, Cleber Bozzi, Domitille Michalon Bertier, Delphine Lebeau, Joachim Correl, David Appel, Isaac Sinclair, Johannes Feser, Didier Gaffet, Martin Koh, Alberto Morillas, Vera Vanori, Christopher Sheldrake, Shyamala Maisondieu, Nisrine Bouazzaoui Grillié, Mariano Cazenave, Claire Liégent, John Maack, Nicolas Bonneville, Seckin Begen, Corinne Cachen, Patty Hidalgo ve Fanny Bal.
